summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting a material change: a 3-for-1 reverse stock split of its Subordinate Voting Shares, effective June 5, 2026, approved by the board. The consolidation reduced outstanding shares from ~698.7M to ~232.9M. Concurrently, Multiple Voting Shares were consolidated at the same ratio to preserve relative rights. No fractional shares were issued; rounding rules applied. This is a capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation like an acquisition or restructuring. The filing is routine and does not trigger a risk-arb event or strategic review.
